info.title: Al Ummah Now sign-in
info.summary: OAuth 2.0 sign-in, accounts and staff APIs
info.description: Every route of the Auth server. x-audience says who a route is for: public (any client), app (our own apps and their servers), page (pages this server shows in a browser) or admin (staff). Only our own apps and scholar sites have clients. scripts/__tests__/openapi.test.ts fails when this file and the code disagree.

get.description: Lists only endpoints, grants and methods this server supports. Cached for 5 minutes.

get.summary: Server metadata at the OpenID Connect path
get.x-summary-ar: البيانات الوصفية على مسار OpenID Connect
get.description: The same metadata plus the fields OpenID Connect Discovery requires. This server signs no id_token. Cached for 5 minutes.
ES256 keys to verify access tokens with, chosen by the token header’s kid. A new key is published before it signs, and a retired one is removed. Cached for 5 minutes: on an unknown kid, fetch again.

Open this in the user’s browser. A browser already signed in to another of our apps comes straight back (single sign-on). Public clients must send a PKCE challenge, S256 only. An unknown client or an unregistered redirect_uri gets an error page, never a redirect. Without client_id and redirect_uri it redirects to the profile app’s sign-in.

parameters.name: redirect_uri
parameters.description: One of the client’s registered redirect URIs, exactly

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: A random value; compare it when the user returns

parameters.name: prompt
parameters.description: With none there is no page: it fails with login_required. With login the person always signs in again. With select_account they choose an account

parameters.name: max_age
parameters.description: Sign in again when the last sign-in is older than this many seconds

parameters.name: theme
parameters.description: The id of a published theme

302.description: To the sign-in page, or to redirect_uri with code and state (or error and error_description)

400.description: An error page: the client or redirect_uri is not registered, or a parameter is missing

post.description: Four grants, chosen by grant_type. A confidential client sends its secret with HTTP Basic (recommended) or as client_secret. Each code works once; using it again revokes what it was exchanged for. Each refresh returns a new refresh token: keep the new one. CORS is open, so browser apps can call it.

200.description: The tokens. With client_credentials there is no refresh_token

get.summary: Who an access token belongs to
get.description: The user’s fields from the token. To check a token on every request, verify it with the published keys instead.

500.description: The server could not read its keys; try again

post.description: For confidential clients, and only for tokens issued to the calling client: any other token answers active: false.
Ends one sign-in. Public and confidential clients may call it, each for its own tokens. Answers 200 for a token it doesn’t know. An access token is accepted and ignored: it expires within 15 minutes.

get.description: Open this in the browser after clearing your own session. It ends the shared browser session, visits each of our apps’ sign-out addresses, and returns. A request that did not come from one of our apps gets a page that asks first.

parameters.name: return
parameters.description: Where to go after; must be one of our apps or a live scholar site

302.description: To the next app’s sign-out address, then to return

post.summary: Start a sign-in on a device with no keyboard (RFC 8628)
post.x-summary-ar: بدء تسجيل الدخول على جهاز بلا لوحة مفاتيح (RFC 8628)
post.description: For clients registered with the device grant, like the TV apps. Show user_code and verification_uri, then poll /token every interval seconds. Codes live 10 minutes.

get.summary: The page where the user enters a device code

parameters.name: user_code
parameters.description: Filled in from the QR code

post.summary: Start a passkey sign-in in a native app
post.x-summary-ar: بدء تسجيل الدخول بمفتاح مرور في تطبيق أصلي
post.description: Studio and Admin apps only. Returns a challenge for the platform’s passkey sheet. The challenge lives 2 minutes and works once.

redirect_uri.description: A registered redirect; the client’s first one when left out

post.summary: Finish a passkey sign-in in a native app
post.x-summary-ar: إتمام تسجيل الدخول بمفتاح مرور في تطبيق أصلي
post.description: Returns an authorization code to exchange at /token with the PKCE verifier.

post.summary: Start adding a passkey in a native app
post.x-summary-ar: بدء إضافة مفتاح مرور في تطبيق أصلي
post.description: Needs a sign-in under 15 minutes old (else 401 step_up_required). A staff member’s first passkey is added on the web (403 email_code_required with setup_url).

post.summary: Finish adding a passkey in a native app
post.x-summary-ar: إتمام إضافة مفتاح مرور في تطبيق أصلي

get.summary: Accounts signed in on this browser
get.description: Our web apps call it with credentials to fill the account menu. Signed out is an empty list, not an error.

delete.summary: Sign out every account on this browser
delete.x-summary-ar: تسجيل خروج كل الحسابات من هذا المتصفح

get.summary: Whether this browser is signed in
get.description: A yes or no, with no account details.

delete.description: Needs a sign-in at most 10 minutes old (auth_time); otherwise 401 insufficient_user_authentication, and the app signs in again with prompt=login. Restorable for 30 days by staff, then erased.

get.summary: The user’s own sign-in data as a download

200.description: Account, roles, identities, sessions, tokens (no secrets), passkeys, audit events and the date of birth

put.description: Only the fields sent change; null clears one. At most 100 characters each.

get.summary: The user’s own date of birth
get.description: With a token issued to the Profile app only. 404 feature_off while the birth_date setting is off.

200.description: The date, or null when there is none

put.summary: Set the user’s own date of birth
put.description: With a token issued to the Profile app only, and a sign-in at most 10 minutes old (otherwise 401 insufficient_user_authentication). A later change keeps the age band or makes it younger; an older one is 409 older_age_refused.

post.description: Ends every sign-in up to now, the caller’s included. Apps that check revocations refuse older access tokens at once.

delete.description: Can be undone. A staff member can’t remove their last one (409 last_staff_passkey).

post.description: Client scope invites:provision. The app makes both ids, so a retry with the same inviteId returns the same invite and sends no second email.

post.summary: Send an invite again with a new link
Replace an invite’s link with one the app made

post.summary: Erase a withdrawn invite before its 30 days end
post.x-summary-ar: محو دعوة مسحوبة قبل انتهاء مدتها

post.summary: End one device’s sign-in, or a user’s sign-ins at one client
post.x-summary-ar: إنهاء دخول جهاز واحد أو دخول مستخدم لدى عميل واحد
post.description: Client scope tokens:revoke. Send exactly one of install_id and client_id. Refresh tokens are refused at their next use; access tokens expire within 15 minutes.

install_id.description: The id a native app sent at /token

post.summary: Ask Auth staff to act on an account
post.x-summary-ar: طلب إجراء من فريق الحسابات على حساب
post.description: Client scope moderation:request. The same Idempotency-Key with the same body returns the first request; with another body, 409.

browserSession.description: The shared sign-in of this browser; sent by the browser

adminToken.description: An admin-scoped client token with the acting staff member in X-Acting-User-Id, or a staff member’s own access token

BadRequest.description: The request is missing something or malformed

Unauthorized.description: No token, or a token that is invalid or expired

NoSession.description: This browser is not signed in

Conflict.description: Not possible in the current state

Unprocessable.description: Understood but not valid; details says why

error_description.description: For the developer, not the user

client_secret.description: Confidential clients, when not using HTTP Basic

install_id.description: Native apps: an id for this install, so staff can sign out one device

scope.description: Space-separated; only scopes the client is registered with

DeviceCodeGrant.description: Until the user approves: 400 authorization_pending, or slow_down (wait 5 seconds longer from now on). Then access_denied or expired_token, or the tokens.

refresh_token.description: Opaque; replaced at each refresh; lives 30 days from its last use

id.description: The stable id of the user: key your data by it

device_code.description: Secret: poll with it, never show it
